questions.explanation: The minute hand (radius 7 cm) sweeps a full circle in 1 hour. Area = πr² = (22/7)×49 = 154 cm².

questions.question: A rectangular sheet 22 cm × 14 cm is cut to make the largest possible circle. Radius of circle and waste material area (π = 22/7) =
questions.explanation: Largest circle: diameter ≤ shorter side = 14 cm → r = 7 cm. Circle area = (22/7)×49 = 154 cm². Rectangle = 22×14 = 308 cm². Waste = 308−154 = 154 cm².

questions.question: Two equal circles (radius 7 cm each) are placed side by side inside a rectangle that fits them exactly. Rectangle area =
questions.explanation: Each diameter = 14 cm. Two circles side by side: rectangle = (14+14) × 14 = 28 × 14 = 392 cm².

A race track consists of two straight sections of 100 m and two semicircular ends with diameter 56 m. Total track length (π = 22/7) =
questions.explanation: Two straight sections = 2×100 = 200 m. Two semicircular ends = one full circle with diameter 56 m (r=28). C = 2πr = 2×(22/7)×28 = 176 m. Total = 200+176 = 376 m.

questions.question: The hour hand of a clock is 3.5 cm. Distance traveled in 12 hours (π = 22/7) =
questions.explanation: Hour hand sweeps one full circle in 12 hours. C = 2πr = 2×(22/7)×3.5 = 2×11 = 22 cm.

questions.question: Area of a circle is 4 times another circle's area. Ratio of their radii =
questions.explanation: If A₁ = 4A₂, then πr₁² = 4πr₂² → r₁²/r₂² = 4 → r₁/r₂ = 2. Ratio of radii = 2 : 1. (Area scales as r² → if area is multiplied by k, radius is multiplied by √k.)
